description: Save a set of creators as a List for the organization, with the brief and filters of the search that produced it. The List takes the name in name, or a name cut from the brief when name is omitted, with a number from 2 appended when another List of the organization holds that name. Each creator is a profileId and fitScore pick: profileId is the creator id from search_creators, and fitScore its fit. The List stores the platform, handle, name, picture, and follower count of each catalog profile, so a creator carries nothing else, and any other key on a creator fails the call with a validation error. A profileId outside the catalog fails the call with a tool error naming it, and no List is saved. Returns the saved List summary. Needs a credential.

country.description: One or more ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes in either letter case, comma separated, such as us or us,ca

creators.description: The creators to keep on the List: the profileId and fitScore of each

fitScore.description: Fit score from search_creators, 0 to 1, or null when unknown

allOf.description: List name. Omit to name the List after the brief in q

platform.description: Instagram (ig) or TikTok (tt), in either letter case

allOf.description: Natural-language brief: audience, brand vibe, or campaign goal

tier.description: Follower tier: nano 1,000 to 9,999, micro 10,000 to 49,999, mid 50,000 to 249,999, macro 250,000 to 999,999, mega 1,000,000 or more, nano+ 1,000 or more, micro+ 10,000 or more, mid+ 50,000 or more, macro+ 250,000 or more, micro- 1,000 to 49,999, mid- 1,000 to 249,999, macro- 1,000 to 999,999. A plus tier means that follower count and above, and a minus tier means that tier and every smaller one.

name: save_list
title: Save list
